authorization: User requested stop-rule change; director fixes TP gross RR1.3 and existing entry methods
baseline: two fixed10pip/RR1.3 controls using the exact previous exits simulator
data_inputs: reuse cached features after source stat/hash checks
entry_rules: existing confirmed baseline preparation/return and exclusions; next available open market OR frozen signalclose-side*signal_priorATR limit, next 3 bars valid; no cancellation-bar rearming
structural_stop: freeze at signal: buy=min(low[preparation_index:signal_index inclusive])-buffer*signal_priorATR; sell=max(high[same inclusive interval])+buffer*signal_priorATR; prep reset/cancel follows existing state machine
stop_quantization: buy floor(rawSL/tick)*tick; sell ceil(rawSL/tick)*tick; absolute frozen SL never moves on entry or later
limit_quantization: buy floor(rawlimit/tick)*tick; sell ceil(rawlimit/tick)*tick; no order if known side*(limit-SL)<one tick, counted separately
fill_risk: actual fill minus absolute SL in favorable-side signed distance. Require at least one tick for a normal bracket; never round actual risk before reward calculation
invalid_fill_rule: Do NOT cancel adverse gap outcomes. Valid order filled with risk<=0 (or positive risk<one tick numerical tolerance) enters at open and immediately exits same open; subtract full cost; record breached_fill_exits. Skip RR calculation in this case; target fields NaN. For limit this opening breach is processed before ordinary pending-center cancellation if both conditions occur.
pending_cancel: otherwise unchanged limit model: previous-confirmed center reached at open cancels before normal fill; no fill plus intrabar center touch cancels; after unfilled bar third-bar TTL/gap/same-side impulse or wick/opposite touch/close crossing new center cancels; surviving center updates after close even though eventual TP is fixed RR
target_rules: Structural cases full fixed gross RR1.3: rawTP=actualentry+side*actualrisk*1.3; buy absolute ceil(rawTP/tick)*tick, sell absolute floor(rawTP/tick)*tick, snapping values within 1e-8ticks of an integer before rounding. Quantized gross RR>=1.3 within floating tolerance, excess less than one tick. Fixed10 controls preserve original implementation exactly. No target update or partial exit.
bar_fill_order: open gap first, then SL priority over TP; intrabar limit entry suppresses all samebar TP but keeps causally reachable SL; opening fills permit normal SL/TP
period_semantics: flat independent yearly portfolios and separate continuous period, warmup available; open P/L separately marked with full cost, no forced exit in PF
final_period_prior_exposure: all periods previously viewed; not untouched holdout
cost_and_fill_model: fixed1.4 and metadata spread/pip+0.2 pips, one full cost at exit; no swap/variable spread/queue/liquidity/broker constraints
position_sizing_and_currency: one fixed unit per pair; pips are equal-pip research scores, not account money
selection: all six training results recorded; structural alternatives eligible only if both costs net>0, net+open>0, >=40 trades and >=6/9 positive pairs. Rank minimum training net across costs descending then id ascending; select one at most, no later fallback
evaluation_access: PRE-OUTCOME DATA-QUALITY AMENDMENT: run all six cases on training ONLY. GBPJPY 2026-08-31 has suspect 2.16 prices/1140 off-grid OHLC values; do not delete/correct rows and do not evaluate validation/final/continuous, even controls. If no training candidate => REJECTED. If selected => NEEDS_EVIDENCE pending separate source investigation/repair permission. Training controls must exactly reproduce old exits artifacts.
pre_execution_data_quality: GBPJPY cache contains 288 suspect 5m bars on 2026-08-31 at approximately 2.16 rather than surrounding JPY quote scale. It is OUTSIDE training 2023-09-08 to 2024-09-08. Other eight symbols metadata-grid errors <3e-11ticks. Source/cache provenance under independent investigation; stop all later-period evaluation, do not treat this as a rounding-only issue.
acceptance_gates: both costs: each period positive net and net+open; continuous >=100trades and >=6/9 positive pairs; final >=30trades and >=6/9 positive pairs
report_fields: PF, net, open, win rate, average closed NORMAL-BRACKET trade risk in pips (breached fills excluded from risk average, never excluded from PF), separately named realized and MTM drawdowns, invalid-known-order count and breached-fill exits; control differences
cross_symbol_rule: same candidate on all nine symbols; no profitable-symbol postselection
stop_rule: six finite cases only; fail => REJECTED, no further optimization
